paper_meta.title: Singlet color center in oxygen-deficient TiO2
paper_meta.note: 输入仅为摘要片段（p1-p3），非全文；章节与字段覆盖按摘要范围评估

notes.claim: 研究氧缺陷 TiO₂ 中一种色心的性质及其与氧空位的关系
notes.evidence: We report an experimental and computational study of a color center in oxygen-deficient TiO2.

notes.claim: 该色心具有单重态基态，与金红石相和锐钛矿相中的氧空位相关
notes.evidence: The defect gives rise to a singlet ground state and is associated with oxygen vacancies in both rutile and anatase phases.

notes.claim: 采用电子顺磁共振（EPR）与光谱学表征缺陷，并用密度泛函理论（DFT）计算确定原子结构
notes.evidence: Electron paramagnetic resonance and optical spectroscopy were used to characterize the defect, and density functional theory (DFT) calculations were performed to identify the atomic structure.

notes.claim: 该缺陷在可见光范围呈现特征吸收带，与氧空位的存在一致
notes.evidence: the defect exhibits a characteristic absorption band in the visible range, which is consistent with the presence of oxygen vacancies

notes.claim: DFT 计算表明单重态源自两个被俘获在相邻氧空位位的电子，而非单一孤立空位
notes.evidence: the singlet state originates from two electrons trapped at adjacent oxygen vacancy sites, rather than from a single isolated vacancy

notes.claim: 氧空位可在 TiO₂ 带隙内形成缺陷态，可能增强其可见光吸收（注意 may 的限定强度）
notes.evidence: oxygen vacancies can create defect states inside the band gap, which may enhance visible-light absorption in TiO2

notes.claim: 该色心在实际条件下对光催化活性的具体贡献仍待量化；对其他 TiO₂ 形貌的普适性未做检验
notes.evidence: the exact contribution of this color center to photocatalytic activity under real conditions remains to be quantified, and that the generalizability to other TiO2 morphologies was not examined

terms.canonical: 金红石相 / 锐钛矿相
